q1.question: How long does a project take?
q1.answer: It depends on scope and pack. A landing or brochure site usually takes 2–4 weeks (Basic). A more advanced web app / e-commerce sits around 6–10 weeks (Pro). A Premium product (design system, automations, run) spans multiple sprints, with a clear roadmap from kick-off.

q2.question: Do you work remotely?
q2.answer: Yes, fully remote. We combine async rituals (Notion, Linear, Slack) with regular syncs and a dedicated account manager. Our clients are across Africa, Europe and the Middle East — time zones are planned into the schedule.

q3.question: Can I upgrade my pack along the way?
q3.answer: Absolutely. Many projects start on Basic or Pro to validate quickly, then scale to Premium when the product needs more craft, integrations or run. Scope and budget are adjusted transparently without breaking continuity.

q4.question: Which technologies do you use?
q4.answer: Core stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Tailwind, plus n8n / AI automations when they serve the business. Infra follows cloud best practices, CI/CD and monitoring. We pick maintainable tools for your team — not tech fashion.

q5.question: Is the quote free?
q5.answer: Yes. After a short brief, you get a clear, no-commitment estimate within 24–48 business hours. Deliverables, timeline and options are listed before we start.

q6.question: What payment methods do you accept, and is there a refund policy?
q6.answer: We accept bank transfer, cards and country-adapted options (EUR / MAD depending on the contract). Projects are usually billed by milestones (deposit at kick-off, balance on delivery). Deposits for work already started are non-refundable; if we stop early, we settle prorata for delivered sprints.

q7.question: Do you offer website migration services or related assistance?
q7.answer: Yes. We handle project takeovers, WordPress / legacy migrations, hosting transfers, SEO continuity and secure cutover plans. A technical audit comes first to reduce risk and downtime.

q8.question: What does your customer support look like, and how can I contact you?
q8.answer: Support via email, Bestcrea chat and the client portal depending on your pack. Premium clients get an account manager and a stronger SLA. Contact: contact@bestcrea.com, +212 636 499 140, or the /contact form — typical reply within 24–48 business hours.

q9.question: What security measures do you take to protect my site and data?
q9.answer: HTTPS everywhere, least-privilege access, secrets out of the repo, backups, dependency updates, and hardened auth (roles, separated environments). For sensitive products: permission reviews, monitoring, and OWASP practices adapted to the stack.

q10.question: What is your development process, and how long does a project usually take to finish?
q10.answer: A 5-step process: analysis & framing → design / prototypes → iterative development → delivery & QA → support / run. Basic often wraps in 2–4 weeks; Pro in 6–10 weeks; Premium across multiple sprints with validation milestones. You get a timeline and regular demos from day one.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Bestcrea collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.note: The French version of this policy is the authoritative version. Any translated version is provided for informational purposes only.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.body: Bestcrea ("we", "our"), a digital agency based in Khemisset, Morocco, places great importance on protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect on bestcrea.com and through our services, why, and how you can exercise your rights.

collecte.title: 2. Data we collect
collecte.body: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, phone, company) through our contact forms, quote requests or client portal, as well as technical data collected automatically (IP address, browser type, pages visited) for statistical purposes.

finalites.title: 3. Purposes of processing
finalites.body: Your data is used to respond to your quote or contact requests, manage your client portal and projects, send you information if you have consented (newsletter), and improve our site and services.

base.title: 4. Legal basis and consent
base.body: Processing your data relies on your consent (forms, newsletter), contract performance (service delivery) or our legitimate interest in running and improving our site, in line with Moroccan law n° 09-08 on the protection of individuals regarding the processing of personal data.

partage.title: 5. Data sharing
partage.body: We never sell your data. It may be shared with trusted technical providers (hosting, payment, emailing) strictly necessary to deliver our services, bound by confidentiality obligations, or where required by law.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.body: Our site uses cookies essential to its operation and, with your consent, audience measurement cookies. You can manage your preferences at any time from your browser settings.

securite.title: 7. Data security
securite.body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures (encrypted connections, restricted access, secure hosting) to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration.

conservation.title: 8. Retention period
conservation.body: Your data is kept for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected (duration of the business relationship, then the legal accounting and tax retention period), then deleted or anonymized.

droits.title: 9. Your rights
droits.body: In accordance with law 09-08, you have the right to access, rectify, delete and object regarding your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@bestcrea.com.

transferts.title: 10. International transfers
transferts.body: Some of our technical providers (hosting, SaaS tools) may be located outside Morocco. In that case, we ensure appropriate safeguards govern the transfer of your data.

modifications.title: 11. Changes to this policy
modifications.body: We may update this privacy policy to reflect legal changes or changes to our practices. The last update date is shown at the top of this page.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.body: For any question about this policy or your personal data, contact us at contact@bestcrea.com or +212 636 499 140.
